feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 8:06am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind warning.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of Ireland. High over northern France, transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally increasing 6 in the southeast of the area this morning, then increasing more generally 5 or 6 for a while late afternoon and this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle, and isolated mist or fog patches in the south, becoming mainly fair later this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle, and poor or very poor in any mist or fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4 occasionally 5, veering west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then outbreaks of rain slowly spreading from the west in the afternoon, becoming mostly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
